title: Spreading a slice
hints: Sum takes ...int, which means any number of separate int arguments. A []int is one argument of the wrong type.
Appending ... after a slice argument passes its elements as the variadic arguments: Sum(xs...).
In Average, call Sum(xs...). In Total, call Sum(a, b, c) with the three separate ints, or Sum([]int{a, b, c}...).
